evidence_firewall: Registry membership does not make a source REAL_PMR or E-INT evidence. Public/academic/method sources are preparation/context only unless a separate admissible claim is promoted through KREATE/EVIDENCE.md.

sources.title: Boğaziçi University SKS 2025 Activity Report / 2026–2027 Goals
sources.authority: Boğaziçi University — Sağlık, Kültür ve Spor Daire Başkanlığı
sources.narrow_use: Institutional dining scale/context: six dining halls, approximately 6,000 daily meals, package-meal and feedback program context.
sources.does_not_prove: Service-level demand, production quantities, root cause of food waste, decision ownership, export access, product adoption or willingness to pay.

sources.title: Campus food waste tracking — 2025
sources.narrow_use: Official aggregate baseline: 2025 monthly food-waste totals and public dining-hall capacity/service context.
sources.does_not_prove: That overproduction caused the waste, service-level intervention effect, campus×meal waste truth, or a model saving.

sources.title: Healthy and affordable food choices
sources.narrow_use: Public context on centralized food preparation and pre-service menu/nutrition/portion information.
sources.does_not_prove: Which role sets service-level quantity, whether campus allocation is adjustable, or whether service-level production/outcome data are exportable.

sources.title: Boğaziçi University Dining Hall official site and menus
sources.narrow_use: Public pre-service menu context and operational navigation.
sources.does_not_prove: Actual served demand, internal production quantity, forecast method, or historical export access.

sources.title: Kilyos meal reservation notice — 20 May 2026
sources.narrow_use: Shows that a reservation-intent workflow existed for a specific Kilyos holiday-service period.
sources.does_not_prove: That the same cutoff, coverage or reservation semantics apply campus-wide or outside that cited period; reservation is not served demand.

sources.title: Boğaziçi University Academic Calendar
sources.narrow_use: Decision-time-known academic/calendar context for future backtests when snapshot timing is preserved.

sources.title: Boğaziçi University Sustainability Reports
sources.narrow_use: Canonical entry point for Sustainability 2025/2024 and GHG Inventory 2025 institutional reports.
sources.does_not_prove: Food-service causal workflow, persona, buyer, pilot effect or demand mismatch.

sources.title: Türkiye’s National Strategy Document on Prevention, Reduction and Monitoring of Food Loss and Waste and Action Plan
sources.authority: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry / FAO
sources.narrow_use: National policy context prioritizing prevention/reduction, measurement/monitoring and multi-stakeholder action.
sources.does_not_prove: Boğaziçi root cause, buyer intent or BOUNCAMPUS impact.

sources.title: UI GreenMetric Sustainable University Rankings — Guideline 2026
sources.narrow_use: Why-now institutional context: 2026 includes Governance and Digitalization and explicit sustainability evidence requirements.
sources.does_not_prove: A university will buy BOUNCAMPUS, that ranking improves, or that the product satisfies any indicator.

sources.title: Machine learning models for short-term demand forecasting in food catering services: A solution to reduce food waste
sources.bibliographic_note: Rodrigues, M.; Miguéis, V.; Freitas, S.; Machado, T. Journal of Cleaner Production 435 (2024), 140265.
sources.narrow_use: Mechanism plausibility and benchmark design: compare ML against transparent/operator-style baselines using real catering data.
sources.does_not_prove: Transferable Boğaziçi performance, causal waste savings or need for ML.

sources.title: Preventing food waste in subsidy-based university dining systems: An artificial neural network-aided model under uncertainty
sources.narrow_use: University-dining mechanism evidence for reservation/show-no-show uncertainty and joint waste/shortage trade-offs.
sources.does_not_prove: Identical reservation workflow, economics, model performance or shortage penalty at Boğaziçi.

sources.title: Food Waste Management Practices and Barriers to Progress in U.S. University Foodservice
sources.authority: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health / PMC
sources.narrow_use: External context that demand forecasting and smaller-batch production are common prevention practices, while measurement practices vary.
sources.does_not_prove: Boğaziçi cause, workflow, priority, measurement maturity or adoption.

sources.title: Systematic literature review of food waste in educational institutions
sources.authority: International Journal of Contemporary Hospitality Management
sources.narrow_use: Multi-causal framing: avoid reducing educational food waste to a single forecasting explanation without stage/root-cause evidence.
